questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: No entry for rickshaws
Only rickshaws may use this road
Motor vehicles and rickshaws allowed

questions.explanation: This command sign gives a specific instruction, it means the road or lane is exclusively for rickshaws. No other vehicles are allowed.

questions.question: When is it illegal to overtake another vehicle?

options.text: When the vehicle in front is driving slowly
On a national road
When approaching a blind rise or a sharp bend

questions.explanation: It’s illegal and dangerous to overtake when your view of the road ahead is blocked, such as near blind rises, sharp bends, or solid barrier lines, you can’t see oncoming traffic clearly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Only vehicles carrying dangerous goods may use this road
Hazard lights must be switched on
Vehicles carrying dangerous goods are not allowed

questions.explanation: This prohibition sign means vehicles transporting dangerous substances (like chemicals or flammable materials) are not allowed to enter or use the road. It’s for safety reasons, especially near tunnels, residential areas, or places where a spill could be hazardous.

questions.question: What must you do before changing lanes?

options.text: Check mirrors, blind spot, and signal
Speed up and swerve quickly
Hoot to warn other drivers

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, you must check your mirrors, look over your shoulder to check your blind spot, and use your indicator to show your intention clearly to other road users.

questions.question: What does this warning sign tell you?

options.text: There is a railway crossing ahead
Trains are not allowed on this road
The road ends at a railway station

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers that there is a railway crossing coming up ahead. It means you should slow down, look and listen for trains, and proceed with caution.

questions.question: What is the minimum safe following distance on a dry road?

options.text: As close as possible to prevent other cars from cutting in
At least two seconds behind the vehicle ahead
One second behind the vehicle ahead

questions.explanation: A two-second following distance gives you enough time to react if the vehicle in front suddenly stops. In wet or poor conditions, increase this to three or more seconds.

questions.question: What does this control sign mean?

options.text: You have right of way at all times
You must give way to oncoming traffic
Oncoming traffic must give way to you

questions.explanation: This control sign means that you must allow vehicles coming from the opposite direction to go first.

questions.question: What is the function of the handbrake?

options.text: To keep the vehicle stationary when parked
To reduce speed while driving
To help with changing gears

questions.explanation: The handbrake (parking brake) is used to prevent the vehicle from moving when it's parked, especially on slopes. It should not be used to slow down while driving.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the rearview mirror?

options.text: To watch passengers in the back seat
To see traffic behind your vehicle
To check the weather behind you

questions.explanation: The rearview mirror helps you monitor vehicles approaching from behind, especially when changing lanes, slowing down, or stopping.

questions.question: What does the accelerator pedal do?

options.text: Stops the vehicle
Controls the steering
Increases the vehicle’s speed

questions.explanation: Pressing the accelerator pedal increases fuel flow to the engine, making the vehicle go faster.
